firstPlayerRule: The youngest player is the Start Player. They place their two Workers first, and play begins with the Start Player.
clarifications: The other player(s) then place their Workers, and players take turns starting with the Start Player.
With God Powers, the Challenger (the most "god-like" player) picks the God Powers, everyone else chooses one clockwise, and the Challenger then chooses the Start Player, possibly themself.
In the 4-player team game, a team's first player places the Workers and the team's second player takes the first turn.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the rulebook linked from Roxley's own product page (roxley.com/products/santorini, Shopify CDN) and extracted text from pages 1, 2 and 6. Page 1 setup step 3: 'The youngest player is the Start Player', who places 2 Workers first; players take turns starting with the Start Player. Page 2: the Challenger, 'determined by who is the most "god-like"', chooses God Powers and later chooses a Start Player including themself. Page 6: team-game worker placement and first turn. The older files.roxley.com 2016 web rulebook has the same start instruction. Copyright 2016 Roxley Games; filename marks the 2017 print. Matches BGG 194655. SHA-256: f485d9488bb129169d33d07c45ac7f97b51b84258b59431dd4463d7e0b01ff0f. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: No tie-break is given if players are the same age.
Games using God Powers use the Challenger's choice instead of the youngest player.
